verdict.rationale: Visa documents a dedicated Intelligent Commerce sandbox. There is a self-serve sign-up form, and after evaluation registration developers can send test transactions in a Test Enterprise Business Center. Test traffic goes to a separate test host (apitest.visaacceptance.com) rather than production, and the docs state the product is 'Free to use in Sandbox.' Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that the sandbox works end to end; documentation of test cards, test data or simulated agent flows; instant self-serve access, since credentials arrive by email after registration.
